title: Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies, B.A. -- CAMS Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies (CAMS) Option (of three: Ancient Languages, Ancient Mediterranean Archaeology, CAMS -- CAMS chosen as the cleanest, since the Ancient Languages option needs specific ancient-language catalog data not yet built and the Archaeology option requires fieldwork the schema can't model). Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New cams_catalog.json (CAMS 5, CAMS 400W). CAMS 400W's own bulletin prereq text is '3 credits in Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies', approximated as CAMS 5 specifically. 'CAMS 00/100-level' (2 occurrences), 'CAMS 100+' (2 occurrences), '400-level CAMS/Language' (2 occurrences), '400-level CAMS' (2 occurrences), and generic B.A. Knowledge Domain/World Language/Elective pools are modeled as generic slots, matching the bulletin's own open-range phrasing. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. CORRECTION (2026-09-18, MAJORS_NEEDING_REVIEW.md wave 2 finding): Semester 1 and Semester 2 had 'World Language (Level 1)' (4cr) and 'CAMS 00/100-level Course' (3cr) swapped relative to the real bulletin. Re-fetched the live bulletin page directly (https://bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/liberal-arts/classics-ancient-mediterranean-studies-ba/, 2026-09-18) and isolated the CAMS-option table specifically (table index 2 of 6 on the page -- bulletin_scraper.py's default table-selection picks the first sc_plangrid table, which is the Ancient Languages option, not CAMS; had to select the CAMS-labeled table by heading text to get the right one). Confirmed: the CAMS option's own Suggested Academic Plan puts 'World Language Level 1' (4cr) in Fall 1 and '00- or 100-Level Course in CAMS' (3cr) in Spring 1 -- this file had it reversed. Swapped the two items back to the correct semesters. This also resolves the previously-noted 'Semester 1 summed 1cr short of the bulletin's 17.5cr total' gap noted above -- that gap was caused by exactly this swap (a 3cr item sitting where a 4cr item belonged); Semester 1's target_credits updated from 16.5 to 17.5 to match. Residual, separate discrepancy found during this re-fetch and left unchanged (out of scope for this fix): Semester 2's 'World Language (Level 2)' item is recorded here as 3cr, but the live bulletin's CAMS-option table states World Language Level 2 as 4cr (Spring 1 subtotal 16cr on the real page vs. 15cr as itemized here) -- flagging for a future pass rather than force-correcting alongside an unrelated swap fix.
